---
name: first-issue-pack
description: Create implementation-ready starter issues for VenturaGenArt from the approved visual MVP and Beta gates. Use when maintainers need small independent tasks that move the scaffold toward a reproducible prototype. Do not use when requirements are undefined or the issue would duplicate active work.
---

# First issue pack

- Read the current visual workflow scope and repository state first.
- Create one verifiable outcome per issue.
- Include model fixture prompt seed or artifact acceptance criteria when relevant.
- Separate pipeline tests API examples and documentation work when independent.
- Keep each issue suitable for one focused pull request.
- Mark dependencies explicitly and avoid speculative model support.
